---
title: "Publicacions"
format: html
editor: visual
---

::: lead
Publicacions científiques i altres resultats de recerca. Sempre que és possible, també hi incloc el codi, les dades, les presentacions i altres recursos relacionats.
:::

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(bib2df)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(knitr)
library(yaml)
library(purrr)

pubs <- bib2df("../data/publications.bib")
extra <- yaml::read_yaml("../data/publications.yml")

# Standardise column names to lowercase
names(pubs) <- tolower(names(pubs))

# Add missing columns if needed
if (!"doi" %in% names(pubs)) pubs$doi <- NA_character_
if (!"url" %in% names(pubs)) pubs$url <- NA_character_
if (!"journal" %in% names(pubs)) pubs$journal <- NA_character_
if (!"booktitle" %in% names(pubs)) pubs$booktitle <- NA_character_

clean_text <- function(x) {
  x |>
    str_replace_all("[{}]", "") |>
    str_replace_all("\\s+", " ") |>
    str_trim()
}

format_authors <- function(authors) {
  a <- unlist(str_split(authors, "\\s+and\\s+"))

  # Remove braces
  a <- str_replace_all(a, "[{}]", "")

  # Convert "Surname, Name" to "Surname"
  a <- ifelse(
    str_detect(a, ","),
    str_trim(str_extract(a, "^[^,]+")),
    str_trim(a)
  )

  # Clean specific Zotero oddities
  a <- str_replace(a, "^Richard P Mann$", "Mann")
  a <- str_replace(a, "^Vidal Tortosa$", "Vidal-Tortosa")

  # Bold your name
  a <- ifelse(
    a %in% c("Vidal-Tortosa", "Vidal Tortosa"),
    "**Vidal-Tortosa**",
    a
  )

  if (length(a) > 4) {
    paste0(paste(a[1:3], collapse = ", "), ", *et al.*")
  } else {
    paste(a, collapse = ", ")
  }
}

make_link <- function(label, url) {
  if (is.null(url) || length(url) == 0 || is.na(url) || url == "") return(NULL)
  paste0("[", label, "](", url, ")")
}

get_extra <- function(key, field) {
  if (is.null(extra[[key]])) return(NULL)
  if (is.null(extra[[key]][[field]])) return(NULL)
  extra[[key]][[field]]
}

make_resources <- function(key, doi, url) {
  links <- c()

  if (!is.na(doi) && doi != "") {
    links <- c(links, make_link("📄", paste0("https://doi.org/", doi)))
  } else if (!is.na(url) && url != "") {
    links <- c(links, make_link("📄", url))
  }

  links <- c(
    links,
    make_link("💻", get_extra(key, "github")),
    make_link("🎤", get_extra(key, "slides")),
    make_link("📊", get_extra(key, "data")),
    make_link("🗺️", get_extra(key, "map")),
    make_link("PDF", get_extra(key, "pdf")),
    make_link("📎", get_extra(key, "supplement"))
  )

  if (length(links) == 0) return("")
  paste(links, collapse = " · ")
}

pubs_table <- pubs |>
  mutate(
    key = as.character(bibtexkey),
    Any = year,
    Publicació = clean_text(title),
    Autoria = sapply(author, format_authors),
    Revista = case_when(
      !is.na(journal) & journal != "" ~ paste0("*", clean_text(journal), "*"),
      !is.na(booktitle) & booktitle != "" ~ paste0("*", clean_text(booktitle), "*"),
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    Materials = pmap_chr(
      list(key, doi, url),
      function(key, doi, url) make_resources(key, doi, url)
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(Any)) |>
  select(Any, Publicació, Autoria, Revista, Materials)

kable(pubs_table, escape = FALSE)
```
